summary_rationale: EQT Corporation remains North America's premier low-cost, vertically integrated natural gas producer, pairing 28.0 Tcfe of proved reserves (93% Marcellus) with owned Equitrans gathering, 53.2% of Mountain Valley Pipeline (MVP A), and up to 6.5 MTPA of 20-year LNG offtake and tolling commitments (3.0 MTPA pre-FID). Operations remain disciplined ($1.03–$1.09/Mcfe operating costs in Q1–Q3 2026, ~$2.00/MMBtu unlevered breakeven, $5.19B 9M 2026 operating cash flow, and $5.59B total debt at Sep 30, 2026). However, Pass 1 footnote forensics elevate kpi_health to PASS_WITH_WATCH under CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL: (1) 2027 hedges pivoted to 462 MMDth with 49% fixed swaps ($3.13–$3.16/Dth) and three-way collars carrying $2.50/Dth short puts alongside $191M in 9M 2026 basis/liquids hedge losses; (2) 9M 2026 LOE and SG&A each ticked up 11% YoY to $0.10/Mcfe while legal/environmental reserves surged; (3) PipeBox sweeps 60% of cash flow to Blackstone ($355.1M in 9M 2026; ~$3.3B remaining Base Return) alongside $13.2B in off-balance-sheet pipeline commitments and $590M in 2028 LNG vessel leases; (4) 94% of upstream receivables sit with non-end-user marketers and ~51% of volume clears in-basin; and (5) the 27%-dilutive Range Resources merger faces HSR antitrust review ($1,148M reverse break-up fee) amid 366,950 shares of 2026 insider sales and zero Q3 buybacks.
